translations.text: Then may the glorious king of nations, [who rules the world], [sitting on the throne], have mercy on you, N., on your soul for ever without end. May the [author of peace] grant you in life the blessings of peace, [salvation of the world], the great Lord [with great power],

and may the righteous one, [son of the highest], come to your aid, [maker of the universe], who was born pure of a noble [virgin's childbearing], [Christ into the world], the Lord through Mary, [redeemer of the world], and through the Holy Spirit.

[Call often]: ask help of him, [merciful God], who was sent [from the highest throne] and announced the birth to the pure one [with a clear voice] [with good will], that she should bear [Christ the king], king of all kings, [by living chastely].

And you should earnestly [?] ask the righteous one for help, [I humbly ask], [the nurturing virgin]; and after that pray joyfully to [all the saints], [blessed and just], that they all [with one voice] intercede for you with the prince [ruling the throne],

the eternal Lord, [the heights of the heavens], that he, [the highest judge], may freely receive your soul, [the eternal maker], and lead it [into everlasting light], where blessed [holy souls] rest in the kingdom, [the kingdoms of the heavens].
